name: semantic/bg-surface
description: Default surface: cards, tables, panels, page body. Grounds aura-fg-primary, -secondary and -accent.

name: semantic/bg-surface-hover
description: Hover fill for rows, secondary buttons and list items. aura-fg-primary and -secondary still pass on it (≥5.8:1).

name: semantic/bg-surface-strong
description: High-emphasis block (the wordmark tile, inverted callouts). Text on it: aura-fg-inverted.

name: semantic/bg-canvas
description: App background behind surfaces; the data-table header band.

name: semantic/bg-inverted
description: Inverted ground: tooltips. Text on it: aura-fg-inverted (17.7:1).

name: semantic/fg-primary
description: Body and heading text on aura-bg-surface and aura-bg-canvas (≥16.9:1 both themes).

name: semantic/fg-secondary
description: Supporting text, labels, captions on aura-bg-surface / -canvas / -surface-hover (≥5.8:1 both themes).

name: semantic/fg-tertiary
description: Placeholders, hints, timestamps, breadcrumb separators. Fixed in 4.1 to pass AA: 4.8:1 light / 5.5:1 dark on aura-bg-surface, ≥4.6:1 on -canvas and -surface-hover. Not for text on aura-bg-selected (4.4:1).

name: semantic/fg-inverted
description: Text on aura-bg-surface-strong and aura-bg-inverted (17.7:1).

name: semantic/fg-accent
description: Links and accent text on aura-bg-surface / -canvas (≥6.8:1 light, ≥9.6:1 dark).

name: semantic/border-default
description: Hairline dividers and card/table outlines. Decorative only: ~1.3:1, below the 3:1 a control boundary needs.

name: semantic/border-strong
description: Creative 2px borders and any boundary that must be seen (17.7:1).

name: semantic/border-subtle
description: Faintest separators inside a surface (e.g. between grouped list items).

name: semantic/accent-dot
description: The lime signal dot beside the AURA wordmark and live/status dots. Visible on dark and strong grounds; invisible on white (1.17:1).

name: semantic/accent-violet
description: Violet accent fills and marks (selection, focus-adjacent emphasis, charts' first series).

name: semantic/accent-lime
description: Lime accent fill (highlights, the Ready status). Label on it in aura-ink.

name: semantic/focus-ring
description: Keyboard focus ring on every interactive element: 2px solid, 2px offset. Lands on aura-bg-surface / -canvas / -surface-hover at ≥6.8:1 light and ≥5.4:1 dark. On mesh and grain surfaces the ring switches to aura-on-texture (violet-700 on the violet-400 pool is only 2.6:1). ADDED — the source defines no focus style.

name: semantic/mesh-from
description: Creative mesh: the violet pool (top-left). Same in both themes — mesh is a light-surface treatment. ADDED from the source's 'violet → lime gradient'.

name: semantic/mesh-to
description: Creative mesh: the lime pool (bottom-right).

name: semantic/mesh-ground
description: Creative mesh: the ground between the pools.

name: semantic/on-texture
description: Text and icons on a mesh or grain surface in every theme: ≥7.3:1 on the darkest mesh point (violet-400), 15:1 on lime, 20:1 on white.

name: semantic/grain
description: Grain speckle colour, drawn at aura-grain-opacity. Visible only on light grounds.

name: semantic/status-neutral-bg
description: Status pill fill for not-started / unknown states (To Do, Draft). Dark theme uses a quiet zinc-800 fill so it sits below the coloured states. ADDED.

name: semantic/status-neutral-fg
description: Label and icon on aura-status-neutral-bg (light 9.5:1, dark zinc-300 on zinc-800).

name: semantic/status-progress-bg

name: semantic/status-progress-fg
description: Label and icon on aura-status-progress-bg (light 7.6:1; dark violet-300, 7.6:1).

name: semantic/status-ready-bg

name: semantic/status-ready-fg
description: Label and icon on aura-status-ready-bg (light 15.2:1; dark lime-300, 9.9:1).

name: semantic/status-blocked-bg

name: semantic/status-blocked-fg
description: Label and icon on aura-status-blocked-bg (6.5:1).

name: semantic/status-warning-bg
